spans.s: नृत् vi. 4P (pp. नृत्त; pres. नृत्यति; desid. निनृत्सति) 1. To dance, ननृतुः सहावम् Bt.iii.43; 2. to represent on the stage; 3. to jesticulate.With उप- or प्र-, 1. to dance; 2. to dance before somebody.With प्रति-, to mock by dancing in return.
नृत् Caus. (नर्तयति-ते) 1. to cause to move; 2. to cause to dance, करकिसलयतालैर्मुग्धया नर्त्यमानम् Ut.iii., Megh.ii.16.With आ-, to cause to move softly, आनर्तितभ्रूलता Am.
